tasks.title: Scaffold package: package.json, tsconfig, tsup, vitest, lockfile
tasks.details: Node 20+, peer deps inngest >=4 <5 + steel-sdk ^0.18.0; no optionalDependencies; nested import/require export conditions; actual-origin repository + MIT license; files: [dist]; committed lockfile and build/test/example scripts.

tasks.title: Types: SteelSessionHandle (JSON-only) and options interfaces
tasks.details: SteelSessionHandle = { id, connectUrl, viewerUrl } — plain JSON, no client instances. Session and scrape options use mutually exclusive supplied-client versus constructed-client modes. Compile-time tests cover JSON serialization and invalid option combinations.

tasks.title: withSteelSession: durable lifecycle wrapper (TDD)
tasks.details: Real @inngest/test replay coverage now proves create → connect/work/close inside one step → release with no post-release resource use. Supplied-client credentials are authoritative, conflicting client configuration is rejected, and sessionId derives deterministically from (runId, stepPrefix).

tasks.title: steelScrape: one-shot scrape helper (TDD)
tasks.details: Stateless scrape via client.scrape({ url }) returning { html, markdown, title, statusCode }. Unit tests cover null-safe mapping, key/baseUrl handling, and compile-time/runtime rejection of conflicting supplied-client configuration.

tasks.title: steelMiddleware: v4 DI middleware factory (TDD)
tasks.details: Public factory returns a Middleware.BaseMiddleware subclass and transformFunctionInput injects typed ctx.steel. The raw class remains internal so the package root has exactly three runtime exports. @inngest/test covers middleware execution; ctx collisions remain last-middleware-wins.

tasks.title: Public barrel export + build verification
tasks.details: Package root exports exactly the three promised primitives. Nested import/require branches select matching .d.ts/.d.cts declarations. The isolated packed-consumer gate passes Bundler, Node16 ESM/CJS, and runtime import/require.

tasks.title: examples/price-monitor.ts + e2e test against Inngest dev server
tasks.details: The served example completed a live Steel + Inngest run on 2026-07-24. It scraped Books to Scrape, returned the page title and price, completed the Inngest run, and Steel confirmed the 120-second session was released.

tasks.title: README: quickstart, lifecycle semantics, security caveat
tasks.details: README uses progressive disclosure: a one-line pitch, short Inngest and Steel definitions, install and quickstart, then API, replay, security, live testing, and development details. It retains the lifecycle and credential caveats without leading with internals.

tasks.title: Publish prep: npm pack dry-run, version 0.2.0, tag
tasks.details: The live E2E and all local release gates pass, and the release materials are complete. Tagging, pushing, and the GitHub release are authorized. npm publication is blocked because this environment has no npm authentication.
blockers: Authenticate npm with an account allowed to publish the unclaimed steel-inngest package.

tasks.title: Docs handoff: steel-inngest integrations page next to AgentKit
tasks.details: The local red-gated draft mirrors the corrected replay-safe lifecycle, bounded cleanup guarantees, client configuration, and session identity. External publication still requires founder review.

tasks.title: CI and release verification matrix
tasks.details: Node 20 CI covers pristine tests, typecheck, build, packed Bundler/Node16 ESM/Node16 CJS consumers, runtime import/require, pack inspection, and production audit. Local clean-install execution passes every gate; the billable E2E remains manual.

tasks.title: Harden durable session credentials and replay behavior
tasks.details: The create checkpoint now excludes the API key, base URL, and connectUrl, retaining only session metadata and a one-way configuration fingerprint. Replay rejects endpoint or credential drift before user work or release, URL query parameters are encoded safely, and test environment restoration deletes originally missing variables. The real @inngest/test state assertion and all non-billable release gates pass.
steps: Add failing regression tests for secret-free checkpoints, replay-stable release configuration, URL encoding, and environment restoration.
Refactor the session checkpoint and client configuration flow without persisting credentials.
